attempts.text: {"claims":[{"claim_text":"Quality, affordable comprehensive health care, medically accurate, LGBTQ+ inclusive, age-appropriate sex education, and the full range of family planning services are all essential to ensuring that people can decide if, when, and how to start a family.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Affordable Care Act prohibits discrimination in health care on the basis of sex.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Affordable Care Act requires insurers to cover prescription contraceptives at no cost.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Affordable Care Act has significantly reduced teen and unintended pregnancies by making it easier to decide whether, when, and how to have a child.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will protect the rights of all people to make personal health care decisions.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will reject the Trump Administration's use of broad exemptions to allow medical providers, employers, and others to discriminate.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
